enchantment.yo_hooks.gentle_touch.desc: The grappling hook will not break fragile blocks such as glass or dripstone.
enchantment.yo_hooks.long_reach.desc: Increases the length of the grappling hook.
enchantment.yo_hooks.agility.desc: Speeds up grappling hook chain climb up and boosts the jump.
advancements.yo_hooks.adventure.sudden_f: Try to cling to a fragile block and fall to your death.
config.yo_hooks:common.desc: Synced from the server. Changes are only applied if you're playing in your own world.
config.yo_hooks:parameters.desc: Changes are only applied after a game restart! Range is synced from the server.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:common_config.funn: Disables fall damage, gives increased range and durability, and allows you to jump even when the hook is down — in short, everything for fun.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:common_config.soft: The hook becomes more elastic, like a spring.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:common_config.stif: Only for soft rope mode. The higher the value, the less elastic the rope.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:common_config.clim: Increase to climb up and down faster.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:server_config.decr: How much hunger is consumed for a hook + jump from it. Climbing the chain also consumes hunger.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:server_config.brea: When attaching, the hook breaks fragile blocks: glass, dripstone, bamboo, ice, hanging sand and gravel, etc. This can also be prevented with the «Soft Touch» enchantment.
config.yo_hooks:server_config.blocksBlac: Blocks that the hook cannot attach to. Example: "minecraft:dirt,minecraft:stone"
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:server_config.whit: Enable this to allow the hook to latch onto only the blocks listed below, rather than ignoring them.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:client_config.hold: Scrolling the mouse wheel will not scroll the hotbar while you're hooked. Useful if you're worried about accidentally falling off.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:client_config.clim: Only works with "Hold Hook Tightly" enabled. Allows you to climb up and down by scrolling the mouse wheel.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:client_config.usin: Using the Hook When a Food in Your Main Hand
When you have food in your main hand and the hook in your other hand, and you're full, the hook can't be used. Useful when you're eating in mid-air and don't want to accidentally fall off.
config.yo_hooks:range.desc: Change the maximum range for this hook. Changes only apply after a game restart!
config.yo_hooks:durability.desc: Change the durability for this hook. Set to -1 for infinite durability. Changes only apply after a game restart!
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:vr_config.remember: Climb the Chain Only With Your Free Hand

On: You can climb up/down the chain only by moving your free hand.
Off: You can climb up/down the chain also by moving your hand with the hook.
yacl3.config.yo_hooks:vr_config.moveAlon:
On: Grabbing the chain and moving the hand along the chain.
Off: Grabbing the chain and moving the hand strictly vertically.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.yo_hooks: Adds vanilla-like and physically realistic grappling hooks.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.yo_hooks: Adds vanilla-like and physically realistic grappling hooks.
